name: War Drum
notes: In game (hwp_war_rc_war_drum, tested): each Warcry and each standard cast steps the Weakness of the enemies around one tier up, to Minor / Normal / Greater by orb level (the tiers assumed).
summary: Skills which apply AoE buffs now will also inflict Weakness to enemies, each new instance stacking increasing the severity of the Weakness on the enemy.
